      Step 1 of 3
      1

      Connect one idea at a time.

      Enter a word that is meaningfully connected to the previous one. It may move closer to the destination, sideways, or briefly take a detour.

      CloserSidewaysDetour
      2

      Reach the landing zone.

      After at least three bridge words, you can finish once your current word is close enough to the destination. The pull meter keeps moving beyond that line toward a strong bridge.

      3

      Finish—or improve your score.

      Once you find a bridge, finish with the score shown or try another word. You’ll see immediately whether it raises or lowers the route score. You have six bridge spaces and three undos.

      The game judges every move in the full 50-dimensional embedding. Only the final map is flattened into 2D.
